description: This PHP file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Validator, which performs validation on configuration interchange objects related to HTMLPurifier's configuration schema. It includes methods for validating directives, IDs, allowed values, aliases, and their respective constraints, ensuring the correctness and consistency of configuration data.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Validator
classes.description: This class provides validation mechanisms for HTMLPurifier configuration interchange objects, ensuring directives, IDs, allowed values, aliases, and types conform to expected formats and constraints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the validator with an HTMLPurifier_VarParser.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a fully-formed HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange object, checking directives and their integrity.

methods.name: validateId
methods.description: Validates an ID object for correct type and properties.

methods.name: validateDirective
methods.description: Validates a directive object, including its ID, description, type, allowed values, value aliases, and other constraints.

methods.name: validateDirectiveAllowed
methods.description: Validates the 'allowed' property of a directive, ensuring it is a proper lookup.

methods.name: validateDirectiveValueAliases
methods.description: Validates 'valueAliases' of a directive, ensuring proper string mappings and constraints.

methods.name: validateDirectiveAliases
methods.description: Validates 'aliases' of a directive to avoid collisions and ensure proper ID format.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Helper function to create a ValidatorAtom for member variable validation.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Throws an exception with context information on validation failures.

methods.name: getFormattedContext
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current validation context for error messages.
